explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration saying that a localization of a valuation ring at a submonoid of nonzero divisors is a valuation ring. I checked every ValuationRing declaration in Mathlib, the RingTheory/Localization directory, and Bezout.lean. The nearest results are Function.Surjective.valuationRing and Function.Surjective.preValuationRing, which cover quotients and other surjective images. A localization map is not surjective, so they don't apply. ValuationRing.iff_local_bezout_domain doesn't give a short route either. Nothing in the Localization directory mentions ValuationRing.
